evidence_quote: Don't see a role that fits? We're always keen to hear from talented people. Email your details to recruitment@udec.com.au and we'll be in touch when something suitable comes up.
employer_line: UDEC specialises in utility services covering gas, electricity, water and sewage relocations, with design, engineering and construction work for contractors around Melbourne, Sydney, the Gold Coast and Brisbane.
